<?xml version="1.0"?>
<robot name="cabinet_single_door_67x59x47m">
  <!-- Dimensions (metres) -->
  <!-- Cabinet overall: 0.67 (X width) x 0.47 (Y depth) x 0.59 (Z height) -->
  <!-- Door: 0.67 wide x (0.59 tall) x 0.02 thick, hinged along the left vertical edge.
       Front faces -Y; back is +Y. Door swings outward toward -Y. -->

  <!-- Base cabinet link -->
  <link name="base">
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="0 0.0 0.295" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="25.0"/>
      <!-- Approximate for a 0.67x0.47x0.59 box -->
      <inertia ixx="1.20" ixy="0.0" ixz="0.0" iyy="0.65" iyz="0.0" izz="0.62"/>
    </inertial>

    <!-- Cabinet body collision (simple blocks) -->
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0 0.0 0.295" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.67 0.47 0.59"/>
      </geometry>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0 0.0 0.295" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.67 0.47 0.59"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
  </link>

  <!-- Door link -->
  <link name="door">
    <!-- Door frame: hinge at x=-0.335, z varies; mid-height at z=0.295 -->
    <!-- Door geometry: thickness along Y, width along X, height along Z -->
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="0.0 0.0 0.295" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="4.0"/>
      <!-- Approximate thin plate: 0.67 (X) x 0.02 (Y) x 0.59 (Z) centered at hinge frame origin for inertia terms -->
      <!-- Using standard box inertia about its centroid:
           Ixx = (1/12) m (Ly^2 + Lz^2), Iyy=(1/12)m(Lx^2+Lz^2), Izz=(1/12)m(Lx^2+Ly^2)
           with Lx=0.67, Ly=0.02, Lz=0.59
      -->
      <inertia ixx="0.0665" ixy="0.0" ixz="0.0" iyy="0.1484" iyz="0.0" izz="0.0237"/>
    </inertial>

    <visual>
      <!-- Door visual centered in its own link frame -->
      <origin xyz="0.0 0.01 0.295" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.67 0.02 0.59"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="door_mat">
        <color rgba="0.6 0.6 0.6 1"/>
      </material>
    </visual>

    <collision>
      <!-- Door collision aligned with the same frame as visual -->
      <origin xyz="0.0 0.01 0.295" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.67 0.02 0.59"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
  </link>

  <!-- Joint: hinge along vertical edge at the left side (from +X looking along +Y) -->
  <!-- Cabinet origin at floor center. Hinge line is at x = -0.335, z=0.295, and along the front-to-back direction.
       The door swings outward toward -Y, so its rotation axis is the Y-axis.
       We set the joint origin at the hinge line: (x=-0.335, y=-0.235, z=0.295) relative to base.
       Door link frame is chosen such that its box center at (0, +0.01, 0.295) yields hinge at x=-0.335 and y=-0.235.
       Door link frame origin thus is at the hinge edge on the door plane, located at y=-0.235 (front surface at -0.235).
       Door box extends 0.02 in +Y direction in the door frame (so it sits in front of the hinge when rotated outward).
  -->
  <joint name="door_hinge" type="hinge">
    <parent link="base"/>
    <child link="door"/>
    <origin xyz="-0.335 -0.235 0.295" rpy="0 0 0"/>
    <axis xyz="0 1 0"/>
    <limit lower="-1.57079632679" upper="1.57079632679" effort="50" velocity="1.5"/>
  </joint>
</robot>
